commit.message: ci(operator): add trusted Playwright MV3 runtime canary

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,117 @@
+name: A2 Browser Operator Runtime Canary
+
+on:
+  pull_request:
+    branches: [main]
+    paths:
+      - 'coordination/chat-control-plane/extension/**'
+      - 'tests/a2_v060_*.mjs'
+      - 'tests/test_a2_browser_operator_v060_*.py'
+  workflow_dispatch:
+
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+
+jobs:
+  runtime-canary:
+    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.head_ref == 'work/a2-browser-operator-v060'
+    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
+    timeout-minutes: 25
+    steps:
+      - name: Checkout PR merge revision
+        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
+        with:
+          persist-credentials: false
+
+      - name: Source and behavioral gates
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          for f in coordination/chat-control-plane/extension/*.js tests/a2_v060_*.mjs; do node --check "$f"; done
+          python3 -m unittest -v tests.test_a2_browser_operator_v060_p0
+          python3 -m unittest -v tests.test_a2_browser_operator_v060_debugger_integration
+          for f in \
+            tests/a2_v060_debugger_broker_lab.mjs \
+            tests/a2_v060_operator_control_lab.mjs \
+            tests/a2_v060_perception_lab.mjs \
+            tests/a2_v060_oopif_perception_lab.mjs \
+            tests/a2_v060_operator_actions_lab.mjs \
+            tests/a2_v060_semantic_actions_lab.mjs \
+            tests/a2_v060_update_manager_lab.mjs \
+            tests/a2_v060_compat_config_lab.mjs; do
+            test -f "$f"
+            node "$f"
+          done
+
+      - name: Chromium pack smoke
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          CHROME="$(command -v google-chrome || command -v chromium || command -v chromium-browser || true)"
+          test -n "$CHROME"
+          "$CHROME" --no-sandbox --disable-gpu --pack-extension="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/coordination/chat-control-plane/extension"
+          test -s coordination/chat-control-plane/extension.crx
+
+      - name: Install Playwright bundled Chromium
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          npm init -y >/dev/null 2>&1
+          npm install --no-save playwright@1.62.1
+          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+
+      - name: Real MV3 service-worker and Prompt Gate browser gates
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          node tests/a2_v060_playwright_smoke.mjs
+          node tests/a2_v060_prompt_gate_browser_lab.mjs
+
+      - name: Deterministic release-candidate ZIP
+        shell: bash
+        run: |
+          set -euo pipefail
+          python3 - <<'PY'
+          from pathlib import Path
+          from zipfile import ZipFile, ZipInfo, ZIP_DEFLATED
+          import hashlib, json, os
+          src=Path('coordination/chat-control-plane/extension')
+          out=Path('METAENGINE_A2_Browser_Operator_v0.6.0_RC.zip')
+          with ZipFile(out,'w',compression=ZIP_DEFLATED,compresslevel=9) as z:
+              for p in sorted(x for x in src.rglob('*') if x.is_file()):
+                  info=ZipInfo(p.relative_to(src).as_posix(),date_time=(1980,1,1,0,0,0))
+                  info.compress_type=ZIP_DEFLATED
+                  info.external_attr=0o100644<<16
+                  info.create_system=3
+                  z.writestr(info,p.read_bytes(),compress_type=ZIP_DEFLATED,compresslevel=9)
+          digest=hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
+          Path(str(out)+'.sha256').write_text(f'{digest}  {out.name}\n')
+          meta={
+            'release':'0.6.0-rc',
+            'git_sha':os.environ['GITHUB_SHA'],
+            'zip_sha256':digest,
+            'ordering_policy':'STRICT_GLM_FIRST_ACTUATED_V1',
+            'glm_first_required':True,
+            'mv3_playwright_runtime_verified':True,
+            'semantic_ax_actions':True,
+            'debugger_broker_v2':True,
+            'oopif_flat_sessions':True,
+            'prompt_gate':True,
+            'authority_effect':False
+          }
+          Path('METAENGINE_A2_Browser_Operator_v0.6.0_RC.json').write_text(json.dumps(meta,indent=2)+'\n')
+          print(json.dumps(meta,indent=2))
+          PY
+          unzip -t METAENGINE_A2_Browser_Operator_v0.6.0_RC.zip
+          cat METAENGINE_A2_Browser_Operator_v0.6.0_RC.zip.sha256
+
+      - name: Upload runtime-verified RC
+        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a
+        with:
+          name: METAENGINE-A2-Browser-Operator-v0.6.0-RC
+          path: |
+            METAENGINE_A2_Browser_Operator_v0.6.0_RC.zip
+            METAENGINE_A2_Browser_Operator_v0.6.0_RC.zip.sha256
+            METAENGINE_A2_Browser_Operator_v0.6.0_RC.json
+            coordination/chat-control-plane/extension.crx
+          retention-days: 14
